name: rung1_check1_fidelity
claim: Rung 1, held-out-line delta fidelity, on the declared 14,121-gene Check-1 panel with 5-fold CV from the shared fold partition. All seven sources verified on the same panel before scoring. measured_delta returns exactly 1.000 as the pipeline sanity check. Both Stack generated-delta variants sit near zero while every baseline is an order of magnitude higher. Scores are NOT comparable to the earlier 2,000-HVG run: scoring on the full panel changes the scale, which is why the rung-0 ceiling must be pinned to this same panel before any fraction-of-ceiling is computed.
